claim.point: Webhook deliveries that fail with a timeout, a 429 or a 5xx response are now retried with backoff, up to 5 attempts, instead of being dropped after the first failure.
claim.detail: About 30 seconds in total with jitter; other 4xx responses are still not retried; each request carries an X-Delivery-Attempt header.

ask.point: Reviewers should confirm whether webhook receivers deduplicate repeated deliveries before this merges.

stakes.point: If receivers don't deduplicate, a retry can deliver the same event twice and repeat its side effects.
stakes.detail: This happens when a slow delivery actually succeeded; for example, a second payment-received email.
